name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 79 - Am 172
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 79 a. Underlines that occupational safety and health (OSH) at work, including psychosocial risks, such as stress, burnout, harassment, is a priority; asks the Bureau to formally recognise psychosocial risks as occupational risks and to adopt a Parliament-wide prevention plan with measurable targets; calls for risk assessments covering telework, missions and tight deadlines, confidential reporting channels, manager training and regular social dialogue; requests an annual report with indicators to the Committee on Budgets and the Bureau; requests a comprehensive report on the “United Against Harassment” campaign detailing support provided, policy and procedural changes and resource implications; requests adequate staffing of OSH specialists and medical services, including psychologists and occupational physicians, and sufficient appropriations for training and prevention actions; insists on the effective implementation of the right to disconnect;
